description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the EmailQueueService class in the OrangeHRM system's core service layer. It tests various functionalities including adding emails to the queue, sending emails, changing email statuses, and processing pending emails.

classes.name: EmailQueueServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing various functionalities of the EmailQueueService component, including email queuing, sending, and status updates.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, instantiates the EmailQueueService, and populates test data from a fixture file.

methods.name: testGetEmailQueueDao
methods.description: Verifies that getEmailQueueDao returns an instance of EmailQueueDao.

methods.name: testGetEmailService
methods.description: Checks that calling getEmailService on EmailQueueService triggers the method as expected.

methods.name: testAddToQueue
methods.description: Tests adding an email to the queue, verifying that the returned Mail object contains correct subject, body, and recipient lists.

methods.name: testSendSingleMail
methods.description: Validates that sendSingleMail correctly configures and sends an individual email via the EmailService.

methods.name: testResetEmailService
methods.description: Tests resetting the EmailService object in EmailQueueService.

methods.name: testChangeMailStatus
methods.description: Ensures that changing the email's status updates the Mail object accordingly, including setting sent timestamp.

methods.name: testSendAllPendingMails
methods.description: Simulates processing all pending emails, verifying the sequence of fetching mail IDs and sending each email.
